name: Tsui no Hi -in the latter half of the 90's-
original_name: 対ノ日 -in the latter half of the 90's-
source:
Main character goes to Tokyo to enter a college. A woman that lives next door invigorates his fantasies. He is confused by his feelings and tries to listen cautiously to his heart. This summer the two bodies will overlap. But it takes something more for thoughts to overlap as well.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-october-2005-ayakashi.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角前往东京进入大学。住在隔壁的一个女人激发了他的幻想。他对自己的感受感到困惑，并试图谨慎地倾听自己的内心。今年夏天，两个机构将重叠。但思想的重叠还需要更多的东西。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-october-2005-ayakashi.html]vndbreview[/url]]
